name: PNC Infratech Limited
summary: An Agra-based highway builder that has constructed packages on several of India's biggest expressways.
about: PNC Infratech grew out of north India's highway boom and is now one of the contractors that big expressways are routinely split among. Long roads are not built by one company — they are divided into packages of thirty or forty kilometres each and awarded separately, so several builders work in parallel and the road opens sooner. PNC is a regular winner of those packages, and also holds some roads under concession where it collects toll.
facts: Builds highway packages on national expressways and national highways.
Also holds some roads under concession, collecting toll on them.
Long expressways are split into packages so several contractors can build at once.
